mapper.insert: insert into cart (goods_id, sku_id, user_id, num, time, spec, price, img) values (#{goodsId}, #{skuId}, #{userId}, #{num}, #{time}, #{spec}, #{price}, #{img})
mapper.update: update cart set sku_id = #{skuId}, num = #{num}, time = #{time}, price = #{price}, img = #{img} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select cart.*, goods.name as goodsName, IFNULL(cart.img, goods.img) as goodsImg, IFNULL(cart.price, goods.price) as goodsPrice, goods.store as storeName, sku.stock as stock from cart left join goods on cart.goods_id = goods.id left join goods_sku sku on (cart.goods_id = sku.goods_id and cart.spec = sku.spec_value) where cart.user_id = #{userId} order by cart.id desc
